headline: Colgate-Palmolive Webcasts 2026 Third Quarter Earnings Conference Call October 30, 2026 – 8:30 a.m. ET
summary: NEW YORK, October 16, 2026--Colgate-Palmolive Company (NYSE:CL) will provide a live webcast of its 2026 third quarter earnings conference call on Friday, October 30, 2026, at 8:30 a.m. ET. The call will be hosted by Chairman, President and CEO, Noel Wallace, Chief Financial Officer, Stan Sutula, and Executive Vice President, Investor Relations, Claire Ross. Investors may access the earnings press release, prepared materials and the live audio webcast on Colgate’s website at https://investor.colg

headline: FTSE 100 today: Stocks slip as Middle East tensions keep oil above $105
summary: Investing.com -- British stocks traded lower on Friday as Middle East tensions kept oil above $100 a barrel, a day after the FTSE 100 closed 1.08% higher, its highest finish in more than six weeks.

headline: Oil prices on track for weekly gain amid Middle East supply worries
summary: Investing.com - Oil prices fell on Friday, but stayed on pace for a weekly gain, as concerns swirled around Middle East supply flows and a bigger-than-expected draw from U.S. inventories.
